style.prompt: An 8-second cinematic promotional video for a lantern night event. Landscape 16:9 composition. Warm amber hanging paper lanterns glow in a beautiful park at blue hour, soft dark navy background and subtle foliage, inviting magical celebratory atmosphere. One continuous gentle camera glide, lanterns sway subtly in a light breeze. A clean high-contrast centered event announcement remains visible and stable throughout, with generous safe margins and no distracting detail behind the lettering. Show exactly these three lines of text, no other words: 'lantern night' as a smaller heading, '14 november 2026' in very large bold lettering as the main focal point, and 'willow park, bristol' in equally large bold lettering underneath. Date and location must be much bigger than the heading, sharp and easy to read. Keep all three lines fully within frame for the full clip. Elegant cream-white typography against the dark park background. No speech, no sound.
